mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies around Verona Area High School with a temperature of 52 degrees, feeling like 46, accompanied by a waning crescent moon phase.

In city news, Fitch-Rona EMS welcomed Liz Gay as the new Deputy Chief of Administration. Additionally, Public Works announced that street milling and pavement repair work will take place on select city streets on November 9th and 10th.

Looking at upcoming local events, you can catch Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today, check out ART House 360 and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow, and join Hop Haus Trivia on Friday.

In this week's police recap, officers responded on Sunday morning to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a driver was found passed out behind the wheel and arrested for an O W I first offence.
Culver's is open today until 10 PM, so head over to enjoy today's flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
